    for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do

    for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(clonedStatements) do

        cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]

        removeQualifiersAndReferences(statements)
        local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(statements)
        restoreQualifiersAndReferences(originalStatements, cloneOfStatements)
